ratios.label: Earnings per share
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the EPS row does not reconcile with the statement's own earnings. It reads 1.241 ZAR for FY2025 against 7.36749 implied by net profit 27724000 over 3763017 shares, a factor of 0.17. One of the two rows is filed in a different unit, so the earnings per share is not verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (rextrueformgrouplimited) is served under two keys, RTO.JO and RTO, whose market multiples disagree (PB 0.09 vs None; PS 0.06 vs None); one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
